text:
Claire (CS): Drafting a concise customer one-pager for go-live: caching, batching, streaming + renewal health signals. Goal = hand to customer + internal playbook. Quick ideas?

Hassan (SE): Keep it tactical. Things customers can copy/run immediately:
- prefill: true, ttl 600-1200s for short sessions
- batching: initial 4, max 12, jitter 20-50ms
- streaming: partial_retry_limit: 1

Maya (CS): Love that. Add a 30-min paired smoke test as a must-do before flipping live. Steps: run top-8 prompts, toggle prefill, observe warmup impact.

Greg (Product): Renewal-risk triggers we can auto-flag in the console:
- cache_hit_rate down by >35% vs baseline (24h)
- p95 latency > SLA + 250ms for >1h
- partial stream failures > 2x baseline in 6h
Map these to CS outreach + SE pairing.

Claire (CS): Customer-facing line: "Enable prefill for bursty traffic; set a short TTL to warm capacity without long idle cost." Short and prescriptive.

Hassan (SE): Pasteable YAML snippet for onboarding repo:
```
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 900
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 4
  max_batch_size: 12
  jitter_ms: 30
streaming:
  enable_streaming: true
  partial_retry_limit: 1
```

Maya (CS): Feedback capture schedule: day0 (24h), day3, day14. Questions: latency ok? errors? top-3 prompts? Capture this in account notes.

Hassan (SE): Debugging tips for SE/cs pairing:
- set jitter_ms=0 for an isolated run to reveal raw concurrency effects
- enable tracing for 5-10 minutes only
- compare cache hit by user cohort (session vs ad-hoc)

Greg (Product): Observability queries to include in docs (promql):
```
# cache hit %%
sum(rate(redwood_cache_hits[1h])) / sum(rate(redwood_cache_requests[1h])) * 100
# p95 latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

Maya (CS): Escalation matrix (customer-facing + internal):
- Latency spike / error surge: CS page oncall + open joint ticket
- Cache regression: CS -> SE triage within 2h + paired smoke test
- Streaming failures: switch route to non-streaming fallback + notify product

Claire (CS): One-slide "value snapshot" for renewals: show before/after med latency, p95, and per-token cost delta from batching + caching. Keep to 1 bullet + 1 stat.

Hassan (SE): Practical prod tip: avoid aggressive quantization during trials without perf/quality evals. Note in doc.

Maya (CS): Add a short customer checklist they can follow during first 48h:
1) Run top-8 prompts (CS observes metrics)
2) Confirm cache_hit_rate > X% baseline or file ticket
3) If p95 > SLA+200ms, enable paired SE debug
4) Paste 3 sample prompts into account notes

Greg (Product): Fallback guidance: If model variant fails, route to a smaller compatible variant and notify CS. Keep the app live, then investigate.

AlertBot: Template created: "CS Go-live Brief: Warmup, Batching, Streaming" by Claire.

Claire (CS): Action items:
- I'll assemble the 1-page + 2-slide deck (ETA tomorrow EOD)
- Hassan: add YAML to onboarding repo and share copy link (ETA 24h)
- Maya: schedule two dry-run smoke tests with high-touch accounts this week

Maya (CS): Customer wording tweak: "For bursty traffic, enable prefill and use a short TTL to warm capacity without ongoing cost." Keep it plain.

Hassan (SE): One more: measure tail latency with and without caching to avoid false positives (cache can mask cold-tail issues).

Claire (CS): Thanks team 44d I'll post the draft here for quick review.
